---
title: "Nemo file manager"
---

Install Nemo and its archive and preview capabilities for shared workstation workflows.

```sh
ansible-playbook -i inventory -K playbooks/lab-stack.yml --tags nemo
```

OCRmyPDF and GROBID continue to own their application-specific Nemo actions; run their tags separately. User preferences, desktop shortcuts, and personal Nemo actions are intentionally left to each user or a personal overlay.

::: {.callout-manual}
**🔧 Manual setup and configuration**

- Choose Nemo preferences and keyboard shortcuts in your personal desktop configuration.
:::

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

```sh
nemo --version
```
:::
